title: Fair micro-loans
summary: A transparent loan application with an affordability check and a plain-language decision.
ideas: Let people without a credit history qualify using rent and phone-bill payments instead
Add a what-if slider: show how repayment changes with a longer or shorter term
Add a 'talk to a human' step with a booking dialog for declined applicants
Translate the decision explanation into simple Spanish and Polish
guide: Pages: src/pages/Apply.jsx (3-step form: about you, money in and out, amount), src/pages/Decision.jsx (affordability result with a plain-language 'why', total cost, repayment chart), src/pages/Schedule.jsx (month-by-month table), src/pages/Learn.jsx (jargon buster). The decision rule lives in src/decision.js: a loan is affordable if the monthly payment is at most 35% of disposable income. Loan maths comes from src/lib/finance.js. Keep decisions explainable and never use gender, age, postcode or ethnicity as inputs.
